title: GPT4o-Receipt: A Dataset and Human Study for AI-Generated Document Forensics
abstract: arXiv:2603.11442v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Can humans detect AI-generated financial documents better than machines? We present GPT4o-Receipt, a benchmark of 1,235 receipt images pairing GPT-4o-generated receipts with authentic ones from established datasets, evaluated by five state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs and a 30-annotator crowdsourced perceptual study. Our findings reveal a striking paradox: humans are better at seeing AI artifacts, yet worse at detecting AI documents. Human annotators exhibit the largest visual discrimination gap of any evaluator, yet their binary detection F1 falls well below Claude Sonnet 4 and below Gemini 2.5 Flash. This paradox resolves once the mechanism is understood: the dominant forensic signals in AI-generated receipts are arithmetic errors -- invisible to visual inspection but systematically verifiable by LLMs. Humans cannot perceive that a subtotal is incorrect; LLMs verify it in milliseconds. translated_title: GPT4o-Receipt：用于AI生成文档取证的数据集与人类研究
translated_abstract: 人类能否比机器更好地检测AI生成的财务文档？我们提出了GPT4o-Receipt，这是一个包含1,235张收据图像的基准数据集，将GPT-4o生成的收据与既有数据集中的真实收据配对，并通过五个最先进的多模态大语言模型以及一项由30名标注者参与的众包感知研究进行评估。我们的发现揭示了一个惊人的悖论：人类更善于察觉AI痕迹，却更不善于检测AI文档。人类标注者在所有评估者中展现出最大的视觉判别差距，但其二元检测F1分数远低于Claude Sonnet 4，也低于Gemini 2.5 Flash。一旦理解了其中的机制，这一悖论便迎刃而解：AI生成收据中的主要取证信号是算术错误——这类错误无法通过视觉检查察觉，却可以被大语言模型系统性验证。人类无法察觉小计金额有误，而大语言模型可以在几毫秒内完成验证。除了人机对比之外，我们的五模型（评估）……
tldr: 该论文构建了GPT4o-Receipt基准数据集（1,235张GPT-4o生成与真实收据配对图像），并揭示了关键悖论：人类虽更善于发现AI视觉痕迹，但因AI收据的主要取证信号是肉眼无法察觉、而大语言模型可系统性验证的算术错误，人类检测AI生成财务文档的能力反而落后于Claude等先进多模态大模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GPT4o-Receipt, a 1,235-image benchmark pairing GPT-4o-generated receipts with authentic ones, and reveals a striking paradox: humans are better at spotting AI visual artifacts yet worse at detecting AI-generated financial documents than multimodal LLMs, because the dominant forensic signals are arithmetic errors invisible to visual inspection but systematically verifiable by LLMs.
